supply.name: stable
supply.rationale: two-week lead, on time, in full

supply.name: uncertain
supply.rationale: two-week lead with a one-week spread and short deliveries

supply.name: mild_lead
supply.rationale: three-day spread: below the engine's half-period lateness slack on weekly periods (3.5 days)

declaration.knowledge_rule: sales knowable at 23:59:59 UTC of their day; the origin week's shelf price knowable at the week start

evidence.demand_history: OBSERVED weekly unit sales (not demand: stockouts are not annotated in M5)
evidence.unit_cost: DERIVED from the observed price by a SYNTHETIC margin
evidence.supplier_relationships_at_walmart: UNAVAILABLE; nothing here was observed at Walmart

final.role: chronological holdout; truth runs to the last full Walmart week in the sales data, ending Friday 2016-05-20 (d_1939); the horizons of the last reviews overlap the public Kaggle evaluation period d_1914..d_1941 (2016-04-25..2016-05-22), which never informed development
